name: @vue-migrate/plugin-store-bridge
description: iter-046: bridge component-side Vuex-style store calls to Pinia store-specific calls. Replaces useStore() (no-arg), store.state.X.Y, store.dispatch('X/Y', p), store.getters.X, store.commit('X/Y', p), and bare commit()/dispatch() calls with useXxxStore().Y(p).
